test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The e-PGPathshala scheme of the Government of India is related to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Higher education'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **e-PGPathshala** is an initiative of the** MHRD** under its National Mission on Education through ICT (NME-ICT) being **executed by the UGC.**
 
• It was initiated jointly by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, CIET, and NCERT, and launched in **November 2015**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The content and its quality is being the key component of the education system, high quality, curriculum-based, interactive e-content in **70 subjects **across all disciplines of **social sciences, arts, fine arts and humanities, natural & mathematical sciences, linguistics, and languages **have been developed by the subject experts working in **Indian universities and other R & D institutes** across the country. 
 
• Every subject has a team of** principal investigators, paper coordinators, content writers, content reviewers, Language editors, and multimedia team.**
